metadata.description: Protocol Admin - governance contract for the Coffer Pool protocol

docs: Treasury governance entrypoints and privileged CPI dispatch.

instructions.name: cancel_action

kind 2 `SetSupervisor` (admin only: the supervisor may not veto its own revocation).

docs: Signer; role checked in the handler.

instructions.name: close_pool_program
docs: Permanently close a deployed program (uncallable + uncloseable).

instructions.name: close_upgrade_buffer

instructions.name: execute_close_pool_program
docs: Execute the pending `ProgramOp` op 2 (kind 12): close the program.

instructions.name: execute_freeze_pool_program
docs: Execute the pending `ProgramOp` op 1 (kind 12): freeze the program.

instructions.name: execute_pool_debug_withdraw
docs: Execute the pending `PoolDebugWithdraw` (kind 5): `token_amounts` and recipients must

instructions.name: execute_pool_set_pool_enabled
docs: Execute the pending `PoolSetPoolEnabled` (kind 7): re-enables the pool.

instructions.name: execute_pool_set_token_active
docs: Execute the pending `PoolSetTokenActive` (kind 8): re-activates the proposed token.

instructions.name: execute_pool_withdraw_sol
docs: Execute the pending `WithdrawSol` route 1 (kind 4, pool-owned account).

instructions.name: execute_set_delay
docs: Execute the pending `SetDelay` (kind 1) once `eta <= now <= eta + 14 d`. Every
`execute_*` clears its slot before any CPI and pins accounts to the proposal.

instructions.name: execute_stld_withdraw_sol
docs: Execute the pending `WithdrawSol` route 2 (kind 4, stld helper PDA).

instructions.name: execute_transfer_upgrade_authority
docs: Execute the pending `ProgramOp` op 0 (kind 12): transfer the upgrade authority.

instructions.name: execute_unfreeze_pools
docs: Execute the pending `UnfreezePools` (kind 9): pools in the proposed order.

instructions.name: execute_upgrade_program
docs: Execute the pending `UpgradeProgram` (kind 11): program and buffer pinned and re-checked.

instructions.name: execute_withdraw
docs: Execute the pending `Withdraw` (kind 3): mint and recipient pinned, amount from the slot.

instructions.name: execute_withdraw_sol
docs: Execute the pending `WithdrawSol` route 0 (kind 4, Treasury PDA).

instructions.name: freeze_pool_program
docs: Make a deployed program permanently non-upgradeable.

instructions.name: freeze_pools
docs: Freeze every `[config_i, pool_i]` pair in `remaining_accounts`. Admin or supervisor.

docs: Treasury PDA; signs the coffer-pool CPI.

instructions.name: initiate_admin_transfer
docs: Nominate a successor admin; sets `pending_admin_eta = now + delay_secs`.

instructions.name: migrate_treasury_layout_v61
docs: Grow a v1 (786 B) / v2 (818 B) Treasury to v3 (1624 B) with a zero tail. Admin only,
admin pays rent; `AlreadyMigrated` at 1624 B. Typed-Treasury instructions fail until run.

docs: Accept the in-flight `protocol_admin` transfer as the Treasury PDA (a PDA cannot sign

instructions.name: pool_cancel_protocol_admin_transfer
docs: Cancel an in-flight `protocol_admin` transfer on a config.

instructions.name: pool_collect_protocol_fees
docs: Collect accrued protocol fees through a Treasury-signed pool CPI. Admin only.

instructions.name: pool_debug_withdraw_liquidity
docs: Withdraw the requested raw token amounts from the pool vaults. Admin only.

instructions.name: pool_disable_range_manager
docs: Force a pool's range manager off (pubkey kept; cannot repoint). Admin or supervisor.
Fails with `coffer_pool::RangeManagerLocked` on a locked pool.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signer; role checked in the handler.

instructions.name: pool_enable_range_manager
docs: Release the range-manager circuit breaker. Admin only, D-class. The manager is enabled
only if it was enabled when suspended and the pool admin has not disabled it since.

instructions.name: pool_initialize_alt
docs: Create the per-pool ALT (address from `[Treasury PDA, recent_slot]`); admin pays rent.

instructions.name: pool_initialize_config
docs: Create a pool config whose protocol authority is the Treasury PDA. Admin only.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config keypair; signs so coffer-pool can `init` it.

instructions.name: pool_migrate_to_v5
docs: v4 -> v5 pool storage migration; mutates pool state. Admin only. `reactivate_tokens =
true` re-opens every deliberately disabled token, so pass it only on the first pass.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA; signs the CPI. `mut` to match coffer-pool's `authority` flag.

instructions.name: pool_redeem_lp_transfer_fees
docs: Redeem a pool's LP transfer fees into the Treasury vault PDAs. `remaining_accounts` =
`[vault_i, recipient_i]×n, mint×n, token_program×n`; recipients pinned to

instructions.name: pool_rescale_virtual_balances
docs: Multiply every slot's virtual balance by `multiplier` (`>= 2`); pair prices unchanged.
Repairs pools violating `virtual_balance > actual_balance`; works on a frozen pool.

instructions.name: pool_set_hook_disabled
docs: Flip a pool's native-hook emergency switch. Instant, admin only. Fails with
`coffer_pool::HookInvalidConfig` on a pool without a hook.

instructions.name: pool_set_lp_transfer_fee_protocol_share
docs: Set a pool's protocol share (0..=100%) of LP transfer fees. Admin only, D-class.

instructions.name: pool_set_pool_enabled
docs: Set the pool-wide operation switch. Admin only.

instructions.name: pool_set_protocol_fee_rate
docs: Set the protocol fee share in bps. Admin only.

instructions.name: pool_set_swaps_enabled
docs: Set the independent swap switch. Admin only.

instructions.name: pool_set_token_active
docs: Flip a token's input kill switch. `is_active = false` (deactivate): admin or supervisor.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signer; role checked in the handler.

instructions.name: pool_withdraw_sol
docs: Withdraw lamports from a pool-owned source above its rent floor. Admin only.

instructions.name: propose_action
docs: Queue a D-class action in its typed `pending_*` slot with `eta = now + delay_secs`
(`SetDelay`: `now + max(old, new)`); re-proposing a kind overwrites it. `UpgradeProgram`
takes the buffer as remaining account 0. Admin only.

instructions.name: register_token
docs: Register a token mint with the treasury and create its vault PDA.

instructions.name: set_delay
docs: Set `treasury.delay_secs` (`0..=MAX_DELAY_SECS`) directly; allowed only while it is 0.
Later changes go through `propose_action(SetDelay)` and wait `max(old, new)`. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_supervisor
docs: Set or revoke the `supervisor` pubkey (`Pubkey::default()` revokes). Admin only.
Nonzero appointment is D-class; revocation is instant and clears a pending one.
The supervisor reaches only restricting breakers; `pool_set_pool_enabled` is admin-only in

instructions.name: stld_withdraw_sol
docs: Recover lamports from the dataless STLD helper (may be drained to zero). Admin only.

instructions.name: transfer_upgrade_authority
docs: Transfer upgrade authority; the destination co-signs (`SetAuthorityChecked`).

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: Incoming authority. Must co-sign (`SetAuthorityChecked`) so a mistyped destination

instructions.name: unfreeze_pools
docs: Unfreeze every `[config_i, pool_i]` pair in `remaining_accounts`. `treasury.admin` ONLY:
the supervisor may restrict, never relax.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA; signs the coffer-pool CPI.

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Drain SOL from the Treasury PDA itself (above rent floor).

types.name: Treasury
docs: Singleton governance account at PDA `[b"treasury"]`. 1624 bytes (v1 786, v2 818; grown
in place by `migrate_treasury_layout_v61` with a zero tail).
Borsh layout, DO NOT REORDER; append only by carving the front of `reserved_v61` (`LEN`
stays). Offsets (`@`) are account bytes including the 8-byte discriminator.
Pending slots: `eta: i64` first (0 = empty), then the absolute payload.

fields.name: admin
docs: @8. Key allowed to call the admin wrappers.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: @40. Nominee of the two-step transfer (kind 0); default = none.

fields.name: token_mints
docs: @74. First `MAX_TOKENS` registered mints. Compat-only: nothing on-chain reads it.

fields.name: token_vaults
docs: @394. Vault PDAs `[b"vault", mint]` of the listed mints. Compat-only.

fields.name: supervisor
docs: @786. Circuit-breaker key: may restrict, never relax (`crate::authority`). Default =
none. Set by the admin via `set_supervisor`.

fields.name: delay_secs
docs: @818. Seconds a D-class action waits between proposal and execution,

fields.name: admin_epoch
docs: @822. Incremented on every `accept_admin_transfer`, which also clears every slot.

fields.name: pending_admin_eta
docs: @826. `eta` of the in-flight admin transfer; 0 = none.

fields.name: reserved_v61
docs: @1613, 11 B. Zero reserve; new slots carve from its front.

types.name: TreasuryLayoutMigrated
docs: `migrate_treasury_layout_v61`: account grew from 786 / 818 to 1624 bytes, zero tail.

types.name: UpgradeBufferClosed
docs: `close_upgrade_buffer`: Treasury-owned loader buffer closed, rent refunded.
